# TMUH Department of Medical Education

> The bilingual website of the Department of Medical Education at Taipei Medical University Hospital, covering its organization, education centers, announcements, honors, teaching resources, and contact information.

## Main pages

- [Department home](https://tmuh-mededu-living-tissue.vercel.app/)
- [Announcements](https://tmuh-mededu-living-tissue.vercel.app/announcements)
- [Quality honors](https://tmuh-mededu-living-tissue.vercel.app/honors)
- [Digital materials](https://tmuh-mededu-living-tissue.vercel.app/digital-materials)

## Education centers

- [Center for Faculty Development](https://tmuh-mededu-living-tissue.vercel.app/centers/faculty-development)
- [Center for Clinical Skills](https://tmuh-mededu-living-tissue.vercel.app/centers/clinical-skills)
- [Center for Evidence-Based Medicine](https://tmuh-mededu-living-tissue.vercel.app/centers/evidence-based-medicine)
- [Center for Education in Holistic Care and Human Flourishing](https://tmuh-mededu-living-tissue.vercel.app/centers/holistic-care)
- [Center for Research in Medical Education](https://tmuh-mededu-living-tissue.vercel.app/centers/medical-education-research)
